changelog: Fix A: the price-range stabilizer only ever looked at loaded candles, never the open positions/pending orders/open ticket drawn on the same chart -- a TP set outside the candles' own range scrolled off-screen the instant a trade opened. btCollectTradeLevels() now unions every such level into the stored range (~3% padding, widen-only, same as the existing candle range), and a new btFitPriceAxisToLevel() safety net pins an off-screen level's pill to the top/bottom edge with an arrow+price+amount, clicking it re-enables auto-scale. Also fixed: an open position's own Take Profit never had a full-width line drawn at all (pill only); Lightweight Charts never re-invokes the autoscale provider on a trade placement alone, so btRenderDrawings() now nudges it every render; a freshly-opened ticket's placeholder stopLoss of 0 was being unioned in and permanently widening the range toward zero.

Fix B: the fill-to-cursor box depended on the same off-screen levels as Fix A -- fixed by the same change. New harness assertion reads the box's real pixel data off the canvas (not just a screenshot) to confirm the fill is actually present and grows with each Next Bar.

Fix C: the Open P&L pill's R-multiple was gross/price-only and could show a positive or zero sign against a negative dollar P&L near breakeven once fees are netted in (confirmed on live: '-$3.42 (+0.00R)'). R is now derived from the same net dollar figures the Stop Loss pill already shows, sign-consistent with the dollar amount by construction.

Fix D: the live challenge's own 'STOP -- weekly trade limit reached' banner was showing on the topbar while a backtest session was open, confusing it with that session's own limits. The banner is now suppressed specifically on the backtest replay screen (every other page is unaffected); the header strip gains this session's own trades-today/max count in its place.

Fix E: position-tool dragging was jumpy -- every native mousemove event ran an unconditional time-snap plus (with the magnet toggle on) an O(n) candle scan for price-snap, and read the chart's bounding rect fresh each time. Dragging now coalesces into one state update + one render per animation frame, caches the bounding rect once at drag start, stays continuous (unsnapped) for the whole drag, and only snaps once on release when magnet is on. Verified via the PerformanceObserver Long Tasks API: a 50-bar drag now produces zero tasks over 16ms.

Fix F: the position tool gains two edge handles (vertical centre of the box's own left/right edges, shown when selected) to resize its own width -- dragging left/right moves only that edge's own time, prices are untouched, minimum width 3 bars. A new drawing's default width is still 20 bars unless the trader drags more than 3 bars horizontally while creating it.
release_notes: No schema change this release -- db_migrations is empty, deploy is Update Now + a hard refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R), no backup or migrate.php step needed. New harness driver tools/ui-harness/drive-v3225.mjs covers the full 7-item verify checklist with a before/after screenshot for every fix, including direct pixel-data and PerformanceObserver-based assertions per the briefing's own 'a screenshot alone isn't enough' instruction -- not deployed, per the standing tools/ui-harness/ convention. drive.mjs and drive-v3223.mjs both still pass unmodified. php -l and node --check clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean. The risk-ladder engine, previously slated as v3.22.5, is now v3.22.6.
